textArabic: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٍۢ لَّازِبٍۭ
translationEnglish: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay.
translationBangla: আপনি তাদেরকে জিজ্ঞেস করুন, তাদেরকে সৃষ্টি করা কঠিনতর, না আমি অন্য যা সৃষ্টি করেছি? আমিই তাদেরকে সৃষ্টি করেছি এঁটেল মাটি থেকে।

translationEnglish: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

translationEnglish: And at night. Then will you not use reason?

translationEnglish: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.

translationEnglish: And he drew lots and was among the losers.

translationEnglish: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.

translationEnglish: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.

translationEnglish: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.

translationEnglish: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.

translationEnglish: So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?

translationEnglish: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,

tafsirEnglish: Tafsir (Surah 37, Verse 151): Exegesis and reflection upon this sacred verse.
tafsirBangla: তাফসীর (সূরা 37, আয়াত 151): এই বরকতময় আয়াতের শানে নুযূল ও গভীর তাৎপর্য।

translationEnglish: " Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.
translationBangla: আল্লাহ সন্তান জন্ম দিয়েছেন। নিশ্চয় তারা মিথ্যাবাদী।

translationEnglish: Has He chosen daughters over sons?

translationEnglish: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?

tafsirEnglish: Tafsir (Surah 37, Verse 154): Exegesis and reflection upon this sacred verse.
tafsirBangla: তাফসীর (সূরা 37, আয়াত 154): এই বরকতময় আয়াতের শানে নুযূল ও গভীর তাৎপর্য।

translationEnglish: Then will you not be reminded?

translationEnglish: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.

tafsirEnglish: Tafsir (Surah 37, Verse 157): Exegesis and reflection upon this sacred verse.
tafsirBangla: তাফসীর (সূরা 37, আয়াত 157): এই বরকতময় আয়াতের শানে নুযূল ও গভীর তাৎপর্য।

translationEnglish: Exalted is Allah above what they describe,
